counting_scope: One read of each of 12 current official FileHandler log fixed-byte prefixes; no stdout, model prompts or archived failed attempts emitted/counts. Last exact Running header bounds current attempt.

potential_default3_overall.reason: Silent no-analysis/unmapped-grid/neutral-component defaults lack definite FileHandler markers. Numeric 3.0 and absent stdout are not fallback evidence.

interpretation: Counts apply only to captured bytes, not future episodes or the full run.
A valid Final response marker after a warning proves a valid parsed selection; observable semantic fallback causes are recorded separately.
Pending/unresolved warning queries are not inferred to have exhausted retries.
Potential missing-numeric-text subset is separately observable and is not the global default3 count.

independent_prefix_hash_verification.method: Read each live upstream log through its captured byte boundary and compare SHA256; all twelve prefixes matched. No source logs were modified.
